Normal review and discard cannot safely select its changes.</p><p>This action discards the entire unreadable pending change file for this account. It can include browser, SSH and console changes, and structural instructions retained after Save draft. Individual changes cannot be selected because their ownership cannot be read.</p><p>The separate saved draft file is kept, and running configuration stays unchanged. Saved draft changes can still depend on structural instructions in this unreadable pending change file; those instructions will be discarded. Other accounts' change files are kept.</p><form method="post" action="/config/recover"><input type="hidden" name="fingerprint" value="3e3b573a979fd2869ef2e8fd4f120b076fbc66821944b9338e40990c6843718c"> <label><input type="checkbox" id="config-recovery-confirm" name="confirm" value="discard" required> I understand that all changes and structural instructions in this unreadable file will be lost.</label><div class="diff-actions"><button class="commit-discard-btn" id="config-recovery-submit" type="submit">Discard unreadable pending change file</button> <a href="/show/" id="config-recovery-cancel">Cancel and keep changes</a></div></form></section></main><aside class="notification-bar" id="notification-bar"></aside></div><div id="notification-area" class="notification-area"></div><div id="diff-modal" class="diff-modal"><div class="diff-title">Review changes</div><pre class="diff-content"></pre><div class="diff-actions"><button class="commit-btn" hx-post="/config/commit" hx-target="#diff-modal" hx-swap="outerHTML">Confirm Commit</button> <button class="commit-discard-btn" hx-get="/config/diff-close" hx-target="#diff-modal" hx-swap="outerHTML">Cancel</button></div></div><aside id="error-panel" class="error-panel collapsed"><button class="error-toggle" id="error-toggle" data-action="toggle-error-panel">Errors</button><div class="error-list" id="error-list"></div></aside></body></html>
